sst_var.description: sst=temperatura °C | anom=anomalía vs climatología °C | err=error estimado °C | ice=concentración hielo 0-1

source.description: 'auto' uses OISST 0.25° default (1981-present): use it for trends, climatology and marine heatwaves. mur_1km (sst_var sst|err|ice) and mur_anomaly (sst_var=anom only) are MUR, for spatial detail from 2002 onward; never mix MUR with OISST or use it for trends or marine heatwaves.

data.values: array[time][lat][lon] — values in units of sst_var

meta.dataset_id: ERDDAP dataset the values come from, e.g. 'ncdcOisst21Agg_LonPM180' (OISST, local default) or 'jplMURSST41' (MUR, mur_1km). Always present; do not mix series from different datasets.
meta.date_range_returned: [first, last] time step actually returned; null if empty
meta.truncated: true if the data returned falls short of the requested range by more than one time step

notes: ice is always 0 in Mexican seas — only useful for high-latitude queries
MUR (jplMURSST41, jplMURSST41anom1day): ~1 km, from 2002, foundation SST, anomaly against a different climatology than OISST — not interchangeable with OISST
